name: Outside-process rack: where finished parts are bagged, tagged and left for the vendor
about: The shop's coating rack (shop.json outside process `coating`, the outproc asset; layout.json item `coating`, in the shipping and outside-processes zone): 48 x 24 x 72 in staging shelving, three shelves. A part going out for black oxide or zinc is brought here from the bench, put in a kraft parts bag with the vendor's tag on it, and left on the waist-high middle shelf, the coating shelf, for the vendor's driver. The world frame is the asset's, its front at -Y as the inspection bench's, floor at z = 0: the asset is the same front and back. The rack's posts and shelves are static; the bag and the part are free bodies resting where they are only by contact. The bottom and top shelves keep the asset's own totes, drawn only: nothing in a take reaches them.

rack.reason: The outproc asset's own posts, shelves and totes (its placeholder STEP's boxes, in the asset's frame); the middle shelf's two totes left off, as the coating shelf is where bagged parts are set, at 940 mm the height of a bench's work
rack.friction_reason: Kraft paper on a painted steel shelf, about 0.4

contact.reason: As the inspection bench's: a steel shelf barely gives, so what rests on it sits at its true height

bag.reason: A kraft parts bag, its top rolled down to stand open, 170 x 140 mm inside and 75 mm tall: room for a 3 in part and the hand that sets it in (at 130 and 150 wide the index or the little finger side touched its walls). Paper standing open is drawn and collides as stiff walls: the walls are 2 mm, a rolled kraft rim's thickness, so the part's corners can't pass through them. About 20 g with its tag
bag.at_reason: On the coating shelf, in front of the operator, 135 mm in from its front edge
bag.friction_reason: Kraft paper on steel, and steel on kraft, about 0.5

tag.on: the bag's near wall, hanging from its rim
tag.reason: A #5 manila shipping tag (2-3/8 x 4-3/4 in), the vendor's process and the job written on it; drawn only, it never touches anything

part_at_reason: Where the part was set down on the coating shelf when it was brought from the bench: to the right of the bag, 155 mm in from the shelf's front edge, under the right hand, the hand that picks it up clear of the bag (at 130 the bag 150 wide kept the fingers off their faces)
